# TotemNexus

Build a travel network around lodestones. Register destinations, discover places you have visited, control access, and use bound compasses or maps to plan a journey. Blocks placed around each lodestone influence the travel structure's capacity and other properties.

## Getting started

1. Place a lodestone and use a compass on it to begin registration and binding.
2. Use a normal Book on the lodestone to obtain the Totem Manual. Sneak-use a Book for Nexus registration or management.
3. Visit another registered lodestone and left-click it with a bound interface item to discover it, subject to its access rules.
4. Open a bound normal compass to choose a destination from its list, or create a Nexus map by using an empty map on an authorized lodestone.
5. Review the quoted cost and destination, then confirm travel.

Bound normal compasses offer a destination list. Nexus maps let you select visible destination markers directly, with zoom and pan controls. Bound Books and Recovery Compasses provide management functions rather than teleport buttons.

The server checks visibility, permissions, costs, and landing safety. Structure materials affect the available journey; the in-game manual and material information explain the current settings.

## Optional recovery integration

With TotemRemnant installed, a death backpack can have an associated temporary destination. Recovering the backpack retires its matching node. Remnant can preserve one eligible Nexus travel item at death. Both mods also work independently.

## Installation

Install this mod, Fabric API, and [TotemLibrary (the TotemCore dependency)](https://modrinth.com/mod/totemlibrary) on both client and server. Current releases require Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, Java 25 or newer, and TotemCore >=0.7.18 and <0.8.0. Other Totem gameplay modules are optional.
